about: Which GPU runs which model, and how. scripts/recipe.py turns a recipe id into the environment scripts/up.sh launches with; the frontend lists what is here. Every number carries {v, measured, src}: measured means read on that card, anything else is an estimate and says so.

cu_per_hour.src: Colab UI figure, never read from ccu-info

vram.src: a 40 GB draw probes at ~39 GiB (scripts/restore.py)

ram.src: Colab's standard A100 shape; not probed here

cu_per_hour.src: Colab /tun/m/ccu-info consumptionRateHourly with this box as the account's only assignment, 2026-09-25 (older docs quote 7.52)

models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
models.quant: GGUF IQ3_S, 3.50 bpw (ISTA-DASLab GSQ-RCO), on Strata

weights.src: 16,384,243,706 B at branch SC_4.00bpw_H5_V6 (Hugging Face tree), embeddings, 6-bit vision tower and 4-bit MTP layer included; the pack's own plot puts this quant at KL 0.0062 vs ~0.015 for the plain 3.50 bpw it replaces

vram_mib.src: derived: 17.1 GiB measured outside the KV on 2026-09-27 (26,746 MiB in all with Q8 KV at 262K) + Q4 KV for 819,200 tokens at 19,584 B each (16 attention layers + the MTP layer) = 14.9 GiB + the second recurrent state slot for two-way decode, 728 MiB (48 GDN layers x 48 heads x 128 x 128 fp32 x 5 for ndt 4, plus conv state); not yet loaded this way

prefill_tps.src: 32,551-token cold prompt, second of a pair, on the A100-40G 2026-09-27 with Q8 KV (4K: 2,935; 119K: 1,435)

decode_tps.src: 512 tokens at 32K context, MTP ndt 4, on the A100-40G 2026-09-27 with Q8 KV (short context: 62.9; ~128K: ~44); Q4 reads half the KV per token, so long contexts should come out a little faster

eta_min.src: billing to READY in 5 min 51 s on 2026-09-27, 43.6 s of it a warm-up since cut to ~8K tokens

context.src: per conversation: YaRN 1.5625 over the native 262,144 (the model card documents YaRN up to 1M); the 819,200-token cache holds two such conversations, decoding together; quality past 262K not measured

vision.src: the tower is quantized to 6 bits inside the shards (needs ExLlamaV3 >= 1.4.4; 1.5.1 here); never loaded

concurrency.src: two jobs per engine step: -ambs 2 gives the second recurrent state slot, and api_server's one conductor thread drives the Generator for both; 2 x 409,600 positions fit the 819,200-token cache; a third request waits its turn; not yet run on this card

host_ram.src: 36.7 of 83.5 GiB in use on 2026-09-27; rcs is 16, not 8: a GDN checkpoint here is ~150 MB (48 layers x 48 heads x 128 x 128 fp32), one every ~2048 tokens, so an 86K-token Codex prompt leaves ~42 of them (~6 GB)

weights.src: 107,463,600,896 B at branch 4.05bpw_h6_ng6 (Hugging Face tree): the 4.05 bpw weights with the 36.36 GiB n-gram table (host RAM, -ngr) and the 6-bit vision tower (561 MB)

prefill_tps.src: gcs sweep at 8192, docs/MEASURED.md (2,806 at gcs 2048)

decode_tps.src: MTP ndt 4 at a 30K context, docs/MEASURED.md

eta_min.src: download 280 s + load 259.5 s + install, docs/MEASURED.md

vram_mib.src: after load at cache 500224, gcs 4096, vision off; with gcs 8192 and the tower together: not measured

context.src: the KV fits (measured); positions past the native 262,144 come from YaRN x2 (rope_parameters + max_position_embeddings 524288, which is how exllamav3 derives the factor); quality there not measured

vision.src: the pack carries vision_k6.safetensors (561 MB); its weights sit in pinned host RAM (EXL3_VISION_PINNED) so the tower costs no VRAM for weights; image encoding speed not measured

concurrency.src: one job per engine step (CONCURRENCY 1); how many live jobs would fit is computed in docs/CONCURRENCY.md, never exercised

weights.src: 83.6 GB on Hugging Face: two IQ3_S shards (3.50 bpw on average; GSQ-RCO picks each tensor's type, the experts mixing Q2_0 and IQ4_NL by layer) with the 28.8 GB n-gram table; ISTA-DASLab, Apache-2.0. Their benchmarks put it level with BF16 (AIME25, GPQA-Diamond, LiveCodeBench v6: 93.26 vs 93.12)

engine_version.src: 2026-10-10 A100-SXM4-40GB trial: official source commit fb58e0dbc8399662c0e47c76578c6e878b14f6cf; CUDA 13 source build with driver 580.82.07; engine SHA-256 81c5e113c48292a723d2cb4ff2613d7be4a79ee559f32292cd6ff07670e10271 (see docs/MEASURED.md). Existing GGUF revision 2a55d75962e22f7a4a1d9963ab6eae3678537831 was reused; engine-only update.

prefill_tps.src: Strata 0.1.41 latest041-v2 on A100-SXM4-40GB, one request per text slice: 12,878 input tokens 1,320.9 t/s; 26,816 1,492.8 and 26,451 1,591.8; 52,323 1,951.0 and 56,363 2,332.8; 110,921 2,515.8 and 110,072 2,566.9. First 12,160-token sample at 2,438.5 was excluded from headline due overlap with aborted run. KV prompt-cache count was zero; Strata row/expert cache state was not controlled. These are observed samples, not an average or n=3; no matched same-box 0.1.24 comparison.

decode_tps.src: Strata 0.1.41 A100-SXM4-40GB, two 512-token output probes: 87.6 t/s after 2,900 input tokens and 93.0 t/s after 21,672 input tokens. One sample per context. Historical 0.1.24 short-context 58.8 t/s was from a different run/VM, not a paired speed comparison.

eta_min.src: Conservative UI estimate. The source-build trial reached READY about 29 minutes after A100 assignment; source compilation, downloads, and Colab scheduling vary.

vram_mib.src: 2026-10-09 trial (docs/MEASURED.md): nvidia-smi reported NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB, 40,163 MiB in use, 40,960 MiB total; point-in-time reading during the v0.1.41 run.

context.src: v0.1.41 runtime config sets --max-context 262144; benchmark prompts reached 110,921 actual input tokens, so the full configured window was not stress-tested.

vision.src: v0.1.41 trial (docs/MEASURED.md) passed an end-to-end 256x128 red-left/blue-right image fixture: response identified Left Red / Right Blue with no contradictory answer. This validates that simple fixture only, not the earlier 640x400/general image benchmark.

responses_api.src: v0.1.41 smoke validated non-streaming /responses completion and strict streamed PONG response; response-ID continuation/stateful operations were not tested.

concurrency.src: Trial validated single-request API paths only; no concurrent-load test was run.

host_ram.src: 2026-10-09 trial (docs/MEASURED.md) free -m snapshot: 85,477 MiB total, 57,458 MiB used, 28,018 MiB available; includes OS cache/accounting, not engine-only RSS.

tools_api.src: v0.1.41 extra-smoke-v2 validated a function tool probe and full function-call roundtrip (report_answer returned exact text 42).
